problem_statement: Build a brand-new /pricing page from scratch for the Modernize Vuejs admin template. The /pricing route does not exist yet (baseline renders empty). Create a Vue view that mounts inside the existing dashboard shell (FullLayout: sidebar + topbar) and reuses the site's Vuetify design system (v-card elevation, primary color #5D87FF, text-h*/text-body typography). The page must present three pricing tiers — Starter, Professional (highlighted as Most Popular), and Enterprise — each in its own card with a plan name, price, a call-to-action button, and a bulleted feature list. Register the route so /pricing renders the page. No interaction required (static page).
required_content: A page heading 'Pricing Plans' with a short subtitle
Three pricing tier cards laid out in a responsive grid (v-row/v-col)
Starter tier card: plan name 'Starter' as an h3/heading, a price, feature list, and a 'Get Started' button
Professional tier card: plan name 'Professional' as a heading, highlighted with a 'Most Popular' chip, an 'Upgrade Now' button
Enterprise tier card: plan name 'Enterprise' as a heading, a price, feature list, and a 'Contact Sales' button
Each card's feature list mentions storage and team-member limits
Route /pricing registered inside the existing FullLayout (dashboard shell) so it renders with sidebar + topbar
design_constraints: Reuse the Vuetify design system: v-card elevation="10" class="withbg", primary color #5D87FF
Use the template's typography scale (text-h3/text-h5/text-body-1) and spacing utilities
Mount the view inside FullLayout so nav chrome (sidebar/topbar) is preserved
Responsive: three cards side-by-side on desktop, stacked on mobile (cols=12 md=4)
author_notes: 方案A. baseline: 显式空 /pricing 路由(PricingEmpty.vue 渲染空 div,避开 catch-all Error404 的正文与 '404' 文本)。reference: Pricing.vue 三档定价卡 + 注册进 MainRoutes(FullLayout 子路由)。bad: 仅保留标题,删掉三档卡片 → dom_assertions(h3 计划名 + CTA 按钮 + storage 段落)全 fail。三份源码 md5 互不同。
